subject: Seat-to-consumption midterm conversion - staged activation proposal
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: laura.chen@greenbyte.com, procurement@greenbyte.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Seat-to-consumption midterm conversion - staged activation proposal

Hi Laura and team,

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our discussion, Greenbyte is hoping to shift a portion of the current annual seat commitment to a consumption model mid-contract to better match bursty inference usage for your new classification pipeline.

We put together a short staging approach that does three things:
- Allow up to 40% of committed units to be converted to consumption in a phased manner across three monthly tranches.
- Provide activation credits to smooth the unit price during the first 90 days after activation.
- Align the converted usage to the existing contract co-term so billing and SLAs remain consistent.

I attached a one-page proposal that lays out the pricing math and suggested milestones. High-level numbers are in the doc; happy to walk through the model if helpful.

Next steps I propose:
1) Please confirm the tranche start date you prefer (we suggested Jul 1 in the doc).
2) Procurement to indicate any PO timing constraints.
3) If acceptable, we will produce an amendment and route to legal for a minimal change order.

If you prefer, we can also do a short 20-minute call with Karthik from pricing on Wednesday.

Thanks,

Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SeatToConsumption-Proposal-v1.pdf]

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@greenbyte.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@greenbyte.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Seat-to-consumption midterm conversion - staged activation proposal

Hi Soojin,

Appreciate the doc. A couple of clarifying questions before we loop procurement in formally:
1) Activation credits - are those one-time per account or per converted unit? Our finance team wants the credit schedule spelled out by tranche.
2) How will unit visibility and reporting look after partial conversion; we need near real-time consumption reporting for chargeback.
3) If we convert 40% as you suggest, can you confirm whether that reduces our committed discount band for renewals?

Procurement here is okay with a staged approach but they asked that any midcontract changes not push our overall renewal band below the current tier.

We expect to have a PO ready by the end of next week if terms are aligned. I attached a short internal note from finance for context.

Best,

Laura Chen
VP Finance, Greenbyte Labs
[Attachment: GB-Finance-Note.pdf]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: laura.chen@greenbyte.com, procurement@greenbyte.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Seat-to-consumption midterm conversion - staged activation proposal

Laura - thanks, great questions. Quick answers and a slightly updated proposal attached.

1) Activation credits: one-time credit applied per tranche, sized against the expected delta in unit spend during the 90-day onboarding window. That means if you convert 40% across 3 tranches, you receive three tranche credits. The exact dollar amounts are in the attached table (line items labelled Tranche Credit A/B/C).

2) Reporting: we will enable a near real-time usage dashboard for the consumption portion and provide an hourly export to your billing bucket. Karthik is copying in the reporting SLA details (minute latency expectations and export cadence) in the attached appendix. We can also push a view to your internal BI if needed.

3) Renewal banding: converting committed seats to consumption under the staged plan will not reduce your current renewal discount tier. We treat this as a midcontract allocation shift and will annualize the converted units back to your co-term for renewal math so your effective committed volume for tiering is preserved. PrIyom has reviewed and approved the accounting treatment; he is cc'd for billing workflow and amendment language.

If that works, next steps:
- I will generate a short amendment with the tranche schedule and credit table.
- Procurement to confirm preferred tranche start (Jul 1 or Jul 15).
- We will target DocuSign by the 29th so PO can attach to the amendment.

Thanks,

Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Tel: +1 415 555 0123
[Attachment: SeatToConsumption-Proposal-v2.pdf]

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@greenbyte.com>

Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -0700

Soojin and team,

Thanks for the clarity - the tranche credit approach and the assurance on renewal banding address our main concerns. Procurement has prepared a PO and attached it here. We would like to start tranche 1 on Jul 1.

Please proceed with the amendment and route to our legal team as well as ours. Once DocuSign is live, procurement will attach the PO.

Laura Chen
VP Finance, Greenbyte Labs
[Attachment: PO_78934_Greenbyte.pdf]
